email.body1:
Lisle, saw UBIX.AI partnered with Holman Capital to take your agentic AI platform into public sector agencies.

Opening a new vertical like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than a team can personally cover before the moment passes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for UBIX.AI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lisle, quick follow-up for UBIX.AI.

Entering public sector means a fresh set of targets, and pipeline expectations usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings UBIX.AI needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lisle, last bit of proof for UBIX.AI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how UBIX.AI's reply rate likely compares to other AI analytics startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lisle, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the Holman Capital push ramps, no problem at all. Timing is everything when you open a vertical, and I know that stretch keeps a sales team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your public sector motion? I'll tailor it to UBIX.AI either way.
